text: Cybersecurity is an interdisciplinary field centered on "protecting the security of information, systems, and infrastructure in the cyber space". It focuses on how to resist cyber attacks, prevent data leakage, ensure the stable operation of critical systems, and ultimately build a "controllable, trustworthy, and manageable" cyber space. It not only involves technical confrontation but also integrates knowledge from multiple fields such as law, management, and social engineering. It is the core discipline for safeguarding "virtual world security" in the digital age.
